subject: set limits with stat_bin2d() produce errors

messages.author: 427356d65a15c6cc
messages.subject: set limits with stat_bin2d() produce errors
parts:
Hi dear all, 

I came across some errors when try to run following code

> d <- ggplot(diamonds, aes(carat, price)) + xlim(1, 3) +
+   opts(legend.position = "none")
> d + stat_bin2d(bins = 30)
Error in seq.default(origin[1], max(range$x) + binwidth[1], binwidth[1]) : 
  invalid (to - from)/by in seq(.)

If you remove xlim, then that's fine.

If you check the last two examples in ggplot2's on-line doc

http://had.co.nz/ggplot2/docs/stat_bin2d.html

they are blank, and I think there would be some datas within this range. 

If you tweak with xlim for a  little while, it looks like I cannot set limits to narrow region which will remove some data points. 


Thanks in advance!
 
Tengfei
